mode: READ_ONLY_PASSIVE: SELECT statements only; no role created, no writes to the target
hash_columns_policy: hash values never leave the target; only equality between expected and observed hashes, and distinct counts, are computed server-side

miners.M1: functional dependencies among categorical columns (comparison, statuses) and the derived predicate expected_hash = observed_hash
miners.M5: does comparison equal a function of hash equality? (derived-field rule)
miners.M6: cadence: inter-arrival seconds between consecutive observations (min, median, p99, max) and gaps over 10x median

settlement_rule: zero violations, >= 30 rows, and an independent verifier formulation with zero counterexamples; otherwise reported unresolved
privacy: only column names, category labels, counts, timing statistics and rule statements leave the target
